name: AH Realty Trust
summary:
AH Realty Trust (AHRT) reported earnings of $0.14 per share on revenue of $52.55 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.13 per share on revenue of $52.86 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 7.69%.

AH Realty Trust, formerly known as Armada Hoffler, is a real estate investment trust (“REIT”) with over four decades of experience.
subject: AH Realty Trust Beat Consensus Estimates
